player_prompt.intro: Igoyo tugo mar PegJump. Ng'ato nyalo donjo e bur ma onge gimoro, kae to ogolo kidi achiel modhi malo mogikno. Gima idwaro chopo: tieko ka koro nitie mana kidi ** achiel** moting'o gima ne oket piny mokwongo. Yo mitimogo gik moko en kaka '[4 1]'.

outcome.win: Wachno oseng'adi ka pod nitie mana kidi achiel kende modong'!
